name.en: Quartz six-sided prism cluster on natural matrix
name.zh: 天然基质上的六方尖端石英柱晶簇

description.en: Use original low-poly facets to emphasize: six-sided prisms with pointed terminations rooted in a natural matrix. Keep secondary texture subordinate to the diagnostic geometry; choose one composition, not counted variants.
description.zh: 采用原创低多边形几何突出：六方柱体具尖端，并植根于天然基质。次要纹理服从识别结构；只计一种构图，不靠变体增数。

reconstruction_notes.en: Original unequal six-sided prisms with pointed terminations, varied inclination and thickness, rooted within an irregular matrix. Solid opaque portable materials with restrained roughness; no complex transparent overlaps, industrial array or reference specimen copy. Nominal size, crystal count, colors and small edge rounding are artistic. Low byte count follows planar crystal geometry; no filler tessellation.
reconstruction_notes.zh: 原创不等大六方柱与尖端，粗细及倾向变化，并嵌生于不规则基质。采用克制粗糙度的不透明便携材质，不靠复杂透明重叠、工业阵列或复制标本。名义尺寸、晶数、配色及轻微棱缘圆厚为美术选择。平面晶体几何文件较小，不填充无用细分。

scientific_scope.en: Independently reviewed original stylized-inspired static teaching art. Palette, pose, nominal dimensions and simplified anatomy are artistic choices; not a strict scientific reconstruction or coexistence claim.
scientific_scope.zh: 通过独立审查的原创静态风格化启发教学美术；配色、姿态、名义尺寸及简化解剖属于美术选择，不作严格科学复原或同域共存主张。
